choice_reason: Four old stalls did not recur in one fixed-case rerun; three new falls have pre-crossing peak object speeds 0.396..0.759 m/s. Contact counterparts remain unknown. Test one simple, nondirected control baseline rather than claim a targeted cause. P2-B has no sufficiently localized explanation and remains unexecuted.
prior_data_role: old trajectories and fixed reruns discovery/calibration only
primary_metric: end-point mean object XY strict <.04 fraction; falls and progress jointly evaluated
randomization: Each new matched scene instantiated once per arm in isolated vector environments; assignment to policy RNG batch slots permuted before run. Same seed does not imply restored states. Single simultaneously sampled batch, paired scene analysis.
data_role: independent validation, not used for choosing damping parameter

measurement_change.change: CC_NEVER to CC_LAST_SUBSTEP only; no solver, dt, substeps, gravity, contact parameters changed
measurement_change.limitation: Last internal substep only; pair identities unavailable; not complete transient contact coverage.
